name: CodeFlist Smart Product Review Lite For WooCommerce
author: CodeFlist

sections.description:
CodeFlist Smart Product Review Lite For WooCommerce is an All in One review pack for your WooCommerce store. It lets you add customers’ reviews and ratings with images and videos with ajax review submission and pagination.

Features Lists
* Display customer’s review or rating with two different layout Grid, List each with 5 different templates.
* Grid layout has column configuration settings.
* Enable only registered or verified customers for reviews.
* Include social media profiles and logo to the email.
* Preview email button to view the configured settings of email before sending email.
* Admin Review Notification Email
* Depending on the different settings available in the plugin, the admin will receive the moderation email whenever a customer leaves a review rating on any product. There are multiple configuration settings like:
* Custom email address, title, logo, subject, review details, and moderation links.
* Preview email button to view the configured settings of email before sending an email.
* Review summary bar with all customer images list.The plugin offers a unique way of displaying review bar along with the images uploaded by the customers. The corresponding review can also be seen from the review bar when these images are opened in the lightbox.
* Show rating under each product of shop or other pages.
* All possible sorting and filtering.Sort with most recent, high to low and low to high rating. Filter with all rating and each individual rating number.You can filter with only verify customer rating and also with only images or video.
* Display review in 4 different position in product page like first in tab, last in tab, at last and after tab to match your site.
* Review Form has multiple configuration settings to match your requirements.The review form is highly customizable and can be selected among the 5 different designs.
* The plugin offers full customization features to add the review title, images/videos with wp editor. The size and the number of the images/videos can be limited by the admin. You can also enable and validate different fields present in the form. Finally, you can turn on Google Recaptcha in the form. There are countless customization features available in the plugin.
* Numeric and load more ajax pagination.
* Show verified buyer customer badge.
* Google Recaptcha in review submission to avoid spam.
* Lightbox to show details of review.
* Enable or disable only verified customer to submit review.
* Compatible with Right to Left and Left to Right directions.
* Support multi-languages.Ready to use in any language.
* Compatible with all the WooCommerce and WP standard themes.
* Fully responsive.

Privacy Notices

With the default configuration, this plugin does not:

  • track users
  • store personal data in the database
  • set cookies
  • send any data to external services

However, if certain optional features are enabled, data may be transmitted to third-party services.

External services

This plugin uses Google reCAPTCHA to protect forms from spam and automated abuse when the feature is enabled in the plugin settings.

It loads the Google reCAPTCHA script in the browser and sends a verification request to Google when a user submits a form protected by reCAPTCHA.

When this happens, the following data may be sent to Google:

  • reCAPTCHA response token (g-recaptcha-response)
  • User IP address (processed by Google)
  • Browser and interaction data collected by Google reCAPTCHA

This service is provided by Google LLC:
Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1.Upload the plugin to your WordPress site, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
2.Activate the plugin.
3.Go to Smart Product Review Lite in the WordPress admin menu.
4.Enable the settings you need and click Save Changes. You can also click Restore Default Settings to reset everything to the default configuration.
5.That’s it! Reviews will now be displayed on your product pages.
sections.faq:
A question that someone might have

An answer to that question.

Is there an option to add multiple images and videos while submitting the review?

Yes, the plugin allows the uploading of multiple images and videos by enabling the Image/videos settings from Review form settings tab.

Can you limit the number of images or videos users upload to the review?

Yes, the plugin allows you to limit the uploading number of images or videos to review.

Where can I moderate the reviews?

You can moderate the reviews from the WordPress Comment review page.

Does the plugin support WPML?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with the WPML plugin.

Is the plugin compatible with RTL?

Yes, the plugin supports RTL.

Can I only allow buyers to review our products?

Yes, the plugin has an option to only allow the buyer’s customer to review the products.

How can I prevent getting spam reviews?

You can enable reCaptcha in review form from the Recaptcha settings of the plugin.
